resources.string: Checking access to the game folder…
Portrait replacement only works in Chrome, Edge, Opera and Yandex Browser: other browsers can't write files to folders on your computer.
This feature is disabled by default in Brave. Open brave://flags/#file-system-access-api, enable File System Access API, restart the browser and refresh the page.
You can change portraits without a browser too: the BDO Tools app for Windows does everything the website does and works with the game folder directly.
Select the "Documents\\Black Desert" folder. The website will read portraits from FaceTexture and the character order from UserCache, and will be able to write new portraits.

Select the "Documents\\Black Desert" folder. The app will read portraits from FaceTexture and the character order from UserCache, and will be able to write new portraits. The folder is remembered until the next launch.
Your own pictures instead of portraits in the character selection window: from your computer or a link, with cropping.
A memo and a class or life skill icon on the portrait; memos go to the account characters window.
Portrait order, sets in Favorites and a backup before every replacement.
Only files in "Documents\\Black Desert" change; the game client is never touched.
Example of the portrait constructor page
The browser is asking for permission to access the "%1$s" folder again. Allow access to load the portraits.
There are no portraits in the FaceTexture folder.
Same order as in the character selection window. Hover over a portrait to replace or edit it.\nClose the character selection window in the game before editing.
PNG, JPG, WEBP, BMP or GIF from this computer.
A copied image (from a browser, Snipping Tool or an editor) or a picture file.
A direct link to an image.
Drag the image with the mouse, use the wheel to zoom. The gaps between cells will not appear in the game.
Click a cell to turn it off: that character's portrait will stay as it was. Click again to turn the cell back on.
Portraits saved. Old files are in "%1$s". Reopen the character selection window to see the changes.
The selected folder has no FaceTexture. Select "Documents\\Black Desert".
The browser did not grant access to the folder. Try again and click "Allow".
Windows denied access to the files in the game folder. Make sure they are not read-only and try again.
The site hosting the image doesn't allow downloading it from other sites. Save the image to your computer and upload it from your device.
Couldn't download the image from the link. Check the address.
This is not an image or the format is not supported.
There is no picture in the clipboard. Copy an image or a picture file and press again; if the browser asks for permission, allow it.

The memo, badge and shade colors of every portrait that has a memo or badge. Memos and badges themselves stay the same, and a backup is saved first. To color one portrait, use its "Memo and badges" window.
Memo, badge and shade colors of all portraits
Click the memo to edit it. The "+" in the center adds a badge: a character class or a functional one; click a badge to replace it.
Up to 24 characters. A long memo wraps onto a second line and the font shrinks to make it fit.
Portrait updated. The old file is in "%1$s". Reopen the character selection window to see the changes.

Sets of all portraits in the "BDO Tools\\portraitConstructor\\<account>\\Favorite FaceTexture" folder: each account has its own. They are saved and applied only for all portraits at once: "Apply" restores the portraits from the set to all current characters, along with memos and badges. The old portraits go to a backup.
Favorites are empty for now. Save the current portraits with the button below.
Portraits from favorites applied. Old files are in "%1$s". Reopen the character selection window to see the changes.
Sets to be deleted: %1$d. The portraits in them can't be recovered.
Replace the set with the current portraits?
The portraits in the set will be replaced with the current ones; the name stays. The old portraits from the set can't be recovered.
The set "%1$s" was replaced with the current portraits.
Pick two portraits at a time to swap them. "Cancel" or Esc to exit.

Pick two portraits at a time and their images are swapped right away, while memos and badges stay on their own portraits. The mode stays on until you click "Cancel" or press Esc. Useful if you swapped characters in the character selection window and the image sliced into portraits came apart. Both portraits are backed up before each swap.
Portraits swapped. The previous files are saved in "%1$s". Reopen the character selection window to see the changes.
No backups yet. They are created before each portrait write.
Checked portraits will replace the current ones.
Memos and badges on restored portraits will be lost. They may remain drawn on the backup image, but you won't be able to edit them or keep them the next time you replace the image.
Portraits restored. The previous files are saved in "%1$s". Reopen the character selection window to see the changes.
Backups to be deleted: %1$d. The portraits in them can't be recovered.
Memos from the portraits will be written to the character memos in the "Account Character Overview" window. Characters with no memo on the portrait keep their in-game memos unchanged.

Close the game before syncing: while it is running, on character switch, teleport or exit it will overwrite the file with the memos from its memory. The website can't check whether the game is running.
The game is running. Close it and click "Check again": while it is running, on character switch, teleport or exit it will overwrite the file with the memos from its memory.
The game is running, memos were not written. Close the game and sync again.
The memos in the game file already match the memos on the portraits.
If you synced while the game was running, it will restore the previous memos on character switch, teleport or exit. In that case, close the game and open this window again.
Before writing, a copy of gameVariable_lobby.xml will be saved to "BDO Tools\\portraitConstructor\\<account>\\lobby_backup".
Memos written. The previous file is in "%1$s". Launch the game to see them.
Re-read the portraits and character order from the game folder.
Swap portraits: pick two at a time. Exit with "Cancel" or Esc.
Restore portraits from backups: they are created before each write.
Save the current portraits as a set or apply a saved set.
Write the memos from the portraits to the character memos in the game.
Upload one image and slice it into all the portraits.
This account's memo file gameVariable_lobby.xml was not found. Log in to the game on this account and log out: the file will appear.
